hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for binary prediction market pools that requires a backend-signed VALS sigma parameter on every swap. Computes a dynamic exponential fee from trade size, liquidity, and toxic velocity, extracting it from the collateral token and forwarding it to a YieldDistributor. Tracks LP virtual balances and updates YES/NO outcome prices after each swap.
